en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: Acquisition of fundamental knowledge of inorganic and organic nomenclature and nomenclature of natural components. Practising on particular examples. Chemical calculation.

Aromatic hydrocarbons.b.Hydroxyderivatives: alcohols and phenols.
